title: Figurity
description: Figurity - addon for Figura that allows you to set avatars for any entities through their NBT
body:
# Figurity

**Figurity** is an addon for Figura that allows you to assign Figura avatars to any entity in Minecraft.

Create custom characters, creatures and world entities using regular Figura avatars instead of being limited to players only.

## ✨ Features

* Assign Figura avatars to any entity
* Works with existing Figura models
* Action Wheel support through commands
* Improved compatibility with player-based avatars
* Persistent model saving
* Automatic model synchronization
* Optimized loading and caching

## 📜 Commands

Assign a model:

```mcfunction
/figurity model set <entity> <model_path>
```

Remove a model:

```mcfunction
/figurity model clear <entity>
```

Get current model:

```mcfunction
/figurity model get <entity>
```

Show available Action Wheel actions:

```mcfunction
/figurity action info <entity>
```

Run an action:

```mcfunction
/figurity action run <entity> <slot> <left|right|toggle> [true|false]
```

## 📂 Models

Place Figura avatars inside:

```text
.minecraft/models
```

Example:

```text
.minecraft/models/npc_models/villager_guard
```

Use:

```mcfunction
/figurity model set @e[type=minecraft:villager,limit=1] "npc_models/villager_guard"
```

Only folders are supported.

`.zip` avatars are not supported.

## 🎭 Useful For

* RPG maps
* Adventure maps
* Custom characters
* Animated entities
* Roleplay servers

## ✅ Requirements

Server:

* Figurity

Client:

* Figurity
* Figura

Without Figura installed on the client, custom models will not be rendered.
